kaikki_vikisozluk.e: لِأَجْلِ عَيْنٍ أَلْفُ عَيْنٍ تُكْرَم • (liʔajli ʕaynin ʔalfu ʕaynin tukram)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Literally: “For one eye, a thousand eyes are honoured.” Compare the polite phrase تُكْرَمُ عَيْنُك (tukramu ʕaynuk, literally “may your eye be honoured”).
g: If someone is highly honoured, those associated with them will be honoured as well.
